sources.title: Tax on shopping and services: Tax-free shopping

observedFacts: In Great Britain, tax-free goods from shops must be delivered directly to an address outside the UK; the source does not provide a luggage-carried visitor VAT refund there.
Northern Ireland has a limited VAT-refund route for eligible visitors who live outside Northern Ireland and the EU, take goods out within three months, and use a retailer's VAT 407(NI) form.
Customs approval of the form and retailer participation are required for the Northern Ireland route.
limitations: This UK market record is geographically mixed: the available refund route applies to Northern Ireland, not to goods carried home from Great Britain.
Rolex retailer participation, the buyer's eligibility, and any transaction-specific refund amount are not established by this evidence.
